cues.en: So at the end of my first year at Harvard,

cues.zh: 有个整个学期都没在课上发过言的学生，
cues.en: a student who had not talked in class the entire semester,

cues.zh: 我之前跟她说过：“听着，你得参与，不然会挂科的，”
cues.en: who I had said, "Look, you've gotta participate or else you're going to fail,"

cues.zh: 她走进了我的办公室。我跟她其实完全不熟。
cues.en: came into my office. I really didn't know her at all.

cues.zh: 她进来时完全是一副泄了气的样子，说：
cues.en: She came in totally defeated, and she said,

cues.zh: “我不该在这里。”
cues.en: "I'm not supposed to be here."

cues.zh: 那一刻对我触动很大。
cues.en: And that was the moment for me.

cues.zh: 因为发生了两件事。
cues.en: Because two things happened.

cues.zh: 一件是我意识到，
cues.en: One was that I realized,

cues.zh: 天哪，我已经不再有那种感觉了。
cues.en: oh my gosh, I don't feel like that anymore.

cues.zh: 我不再有那种感觉了，但她有，而我懂那种感觉。
cues.en: I don't feel that anymore, but she does, and I get that feeling.

cues.zh: 第二件事是，她就该在这里！
cues.en: And the second was, she is supposed to be here!

cues.zh: 她可以假装做到，然后真的做到。
cues.en: Like, she can fake it, she can become it.

cues.zh: 所以我说：“对，你就是！你就该在这里！
cues.en: So I was like, "Yes, you are! You are supposed to be here!

cues.zh: 明天你就去假装，
cues.en: And tomorrow you're going to fake it,

cues.zh: 让你自己变得强大，然后，你知道——
cues.en: you're going to make yourself powerful, and, you know --

cues.zh: （掌声）
cues.en: (Applause)

cues.zh: 然后你走进教室，
cues.en: And you're going to go into the classroom,

cues.zh: 给出有史以来最棒的发言。”
cues.en: and you are going to give the best comment ever."

cues.zh: 你知道吗？她给出了最棒的评论，
cues.en: You know? And she gave the best comment ever,

cues.zh: 然后大家都转过头来，说，
cues.en: and people turned around and were like,

cues.zh: 天哪，我都没注意到她坐在那儿。（笑声）
cues.en: oh my God, I didn't even notice her sitting there. (Laughter)

cues.zh: 几个月后她回来找我，
cues.en: She comes back to me months later,

cues.zh: 我才意识到，她不只是假装成功直到真的成功，
cues.en: and I realized that she had not just faked it till she made it,

cues.zh: 她其实是假装，直到自己真的变成了那样。
cues.en: she had actually faked it till she became it.

cues.zh: 所以她改变了。
cues.en: So she had changed.

cues.zh: 所以我想对你们说，不要假装成功直到真的成功。
cues.en: And so I want to say to you, don't fake it till you make it.

cues.zh: 假装，直到你真正成为它。
cues.en: Fake it till you become it.

cues.zh: 做得足够多，直到你真正成为它并内化。
cues.en: Do it enough until you actually become it and internalize.

cues.zh: 最后我要留给你们的是这一点。
cues.en: The last thing I'm going to leave you with is this.

cues.zh: 微小的调整能带来巨大的改变。
cues.en: Tiny tweaks can lead to big changes.

cues.zh: 所以，就两分钟。
cues.en: So, this is two minutes.

cues.zh: 两分钟，两分钟，两分钟。
cues.en: Two minutes, two minutes, two minutes.

cues.zh: 在你进入下一个充满压力的评估场合之前，
cues.en: Before you go into the next stressful evaluative situation,

cues.zh: 花两分钟，试试这样做，在电梯里，
cues.en: for two minutes, try doing this, in the elevator,

cues.zh: 在洗手间隔间里，在办公桌前关上门。
cues.en: in a bathroom stall, at your desk behind closed doors.

cues.zh: 这就是你想做的事。
cues.en: That's what you want to do.

cues.zh: 让大脑调整到最适合那种情况的状态。
cues.en: Configure your brain to cope the best in that situation.

cues.zh: 提高你的睾酮水平，降低你的皮质醇水平。
cues.en: Get your testosterone up. Get your cortisol down.

cues.zh: 别在离开那个情境时觉得：唉，我没让他们看到我是谁。
cues.en: Don't leave that situation feeling like, oh, I didn't show them who I am.

cues.zh: 离开那个情境时要觉得：
cues.en: Leave that situation feeling like,

cues.zh: 我真觉得我必须说出我是谁，展示我是谁。
cues.en: I really feel like I got to say who I am and show who I am.

cues.zh: 所以我想先请你试试摆出有力的姿势，
cues.en: So I want to ask you first, you know, both to try power posing,

cues.zh: 还想请你分享这门科学，因为它很简单。
cues.en: and also I want to ask you to share the science, because this is simple.

cues.zh: 这里面没有我的个人面子问题。（笑声）
cues.en: I don't have ego involved in this. (Laughter)

cues.zh: 把它分享出去。传给别人，
cues.en: Give it away. Share it with people,

cues.zh: 因为最能从中受益的人
cues.en: because the people who can use it the most

cues.zh: 正是那些没有资源、没有技术、
cues.en: are the ones with no resources and no technology

cues.zh: 没有地位、没有权力的人。
cues.en: and no status and no power.

cues.zh: 把它给他们，因为他们可以私下做。
cues.en: Give it to them because they can do it in private.

cues.zh: 他们只需要自己的身体、一点隐私和两分钟，
cues.en: They need their bodies, privacy and two minutes,

cues.zh: 就能显著改变人生的结果。
cues.en: and it can significantly change the outcomes of their life.

cues.zh: 谢谢。
cues.en: Thank you.

cues.zh: （掌声）
cues.en: (Applause)
